spec.name: 5th Space — off-grid canal barge (mobile community venue)
spec.rationale: A large canal barge, solar + lithium off-grid, that sails the UK canal/river network and moors at the towns the AI flags. It combats loneliness by arriving before the crisis — a warm room, on the water, with no postcode lottery. Models the CIC's pillar-2 delivery as a mobile venue.

interventions.equity_note: Higher expected benefit in this high-need area; monitor differential take-up across older and isolated groups.
interventions.stop_condition: Review at week 8; stop expansion if completion <35% or access gap widens in Spelthorne. Escalate to safeguarding lead if self-harm risk indicated.
